agent_explanation: Shrunk actuated intersection with detector_fail E from t=203 (duration 159) starves NS. EW green starts at ~148 and is held continuously through step 346 (>190s, exceeding max_green_seconds=87) despite large NS queues. The failed E detector makes EW appear partly empty (E queue 0) but W still queued, so actuated gap-out logic never sees EW empty, and max_green / wait-recall logic fails to force a switch (likely treats failed detector as suppressing recall). NS waits grow from 58s at failure start to 200s at step 345 and 201s at step 346, violating max_wait. Removing the detector_fail restores normal cycling and no violation.
